race.description: Inglis Xtra Bonus Showcase Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ESSAY (10) is back after a 19-week spell. Raced just once last prep and missed the placings over 1000m at Hawkesbury as a $1.80 chance. Likely to find today's trip far more to her liking. Comfortable recent trial winner who is primed to run a big race. SWEET HARRY (4) last appeared when a distant second on debut over 1000m at Canberra ten weeks ago. Took out a Canberra trial on 3 November. Draws a lovely gate and should be right there at the business end. BRUCEDALE (1) returned from an 18-month spell with an encouraging second over this trip at Albury recently, beaten narrowly. Should kick on following that hit-out. Blinkers on, which is a sign of intent from the stable. SCATTERED SANDS (11) won a trial at Hawkesbury on 20 October and looks ready to make a positive debut. COSMIC RIVER (2) can improve on a modest first-up effort at Kembla.
